usage: The word '雙拼' is a noun used to describe a combination of two items served together, commonly in food menus.
It is used to specify when you want two different dishes or ingredients combined in one order.
In sentences, it usually follows the number or comes directly before the dish types to indicate the combo.
It can also be used when ordering at a restaurant to ask for a two-item combo plate.
The word does not change form in plural or singular usage.

examples.meaning: I want to order a two-item combo rice.
